name: Reika
source:
Aiming to become a professional bowler, Reika's passion to the sport is so strong she spends a large amount of her free time at the bowling alley. She enjoys music and exercise and excelled in both during high school, so she has not only confidence in her singing abilities, but also her stamina for dancing. She's a friendly and energetic big sister type, but a couple of drinks will bring out her forceful side. Being from Osaka, she often worries about her little sister back home.

[spoiler]Her real name is Akabane Chitose (赤羽ちとせ).[/spoiler]
